question: From what point and in what posture must the sequence proceed with the Īśa mantra?
premises: One knee rests on the ground
The sequence proceeds from the head in order
inference: With one knee on the ground and the Īśa mantra, one proceeds in order beginning from the head.
plain_english: With one knee on the ground, using the Īśa mantra, one should proceed in order beginning from the head.
